summary: Full backend + frontend testing of WedSnap. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/logout/register/me + RBAC), weddings CRUD, QR generation, public guest upload (photo + unsupported rejection), guest message, gallery list/messages/favorite/serve-file/zip download, admin analytics/restaurants/plan-change/suspend, cross-role access denial. Frontend Playwright covered: admin login lands /admin, restaurant table + analytics visible, plan dropdown works (Pro applied), suspend buttons present, logout redirects to /login, restaurant login lands /dashboard, new wedding creation dialog submits and appears (4 cards visible after), wedding detail QR generation + qr-image + download-qr + copy-link, gallery filters (all/photo/video/favorites), views (grid/timeline/messages), search, favorite toggle, delete buttons, guest public page loads with couple-names, file-input, dropzone, guest-name, guest-message, upload-submit all present, protected routes /dashboard and /admin redirect unauth to /login.

issues: 'wedding-date' uses native browser type=date picker instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent} - a11y issue, add DialogDescription

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace native <input type=date> with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for consistent styling.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to shadcn DialogContent components to silence a11y warnings.

OPTIONAL: EmailStr validator rejects .test / .local TLDs (e.g., 422 on TEST_...@wedsnap.test). Considered acceptable since real users won't hit this, but couple auto-create with such an email would silently fail validation earlier.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 640+ lines is fine but growing; consider splitting into routers (auth, weddings, gallery, admin) as it grows.
storage.py init_storage() uses a global storage_key without a lock. Under concurrent uploads this is race-prone; fine for MVP.
set_auth_cookies uses secure=True + samesite=none which requires HTTPS (works in preview) - correct for prod.
guest_upload trusts client content_type but also enforces via extension + size limits per media type - good.
Admin route PATCH /admin/restaurants updates status but there is no dedicated 'audit_logs' viewer endpoint - not required for MVP.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Consider adding for production.
